args.details: Parse the structured (JSON) application log format into the canonical log_event schema: normalize timestamps to UTC, map level/service/request id/status/latency, and preserve the raw payload for debugging. Malformed JSON lines are counted as unparseable rather than failing the batch. Deliverable: parser module + fixture tests asserting >= 99% parse success on real JSON samples. Covers the JSON source only; plaintext formats handled separately.
args.name: JSON log parser with UTC timestamp normalization

initial_arguments.name: Structured log parser for JSON and plaintext sources
initial_arguments.details: Parse each inventoried format into the canonical log_event schema: timestamp normalization to UTC, level, service, request id, status code, latency, message. Handle multi-line stack traces by attributing them to the preceding record, and count unparseable lines instead of failing the batch. Deliverable: parser module + fixtures tests asserting parse success rate >= 99% on real samples.

args.details: Compose the traffic and performance half of the operational panel from existing primitives and query hooks: request volume over time, latency percentile band (p50/p95/p99), and an error-rate trend with a configurable threshold line. Deliverable: view section + component tests with mocked queries. Reuses primitives; no new chart types.
args.name: Operational view: traffic, latency and error-rate panels

initial_arguments.name: Operational health view (traffic, errors, latency, top signatures)
initial_arguments.details: Compose the log-derived panel: request volume, error-rate trend with threshold line, latency percentile band, and a ranked table of error signatures with anomaly badges. Deliverable: view route + component tests with mocked queries, reusing the same primitives as the customer view.

args.details: Lay out the assembled dashboard page: responsive grid placing the customer and operational views, a global date-range/segment filter bar that all panels read from, and a last-refreshed timestamp. Deliverable: `/dashboard` route rendering both views against seeded data with the global filter wired through.
args.name: Dashboard layout and global filter bar

initial_arguments.name: Dashboard assembly: layout, global filters and refresh
initial_arguments.details: Assemble both views into a single dashboard page with a responsive grid layout, a global date-range/segment filter that all panels react to, last-refreshed indicator, and a manual refresh action. Add empty/error handling when the store has no data. Deliverable: `/dashboard` route + an end-to-end smoke test loading the page against seeded data.
